title: Comparative Security of Haystack-PubDS+ISW
summary: No attacks specific to public dummy shuffling are known; determine whether Haystack-PubDS+ISW has security comparable to Haystack-DS+ISW.

formal_statement.body: Determine through cryptanalysis whether Haystack-PubDS+ISW has security comparable to Haystack-DS+ISW. No attacks specific to public dummy shuffling are known, but public dummy shuffling has reduced combinatorial complexity because each slot is shuffled separately by the same permutation. Analyze Haystack-PubDS+ISW using the parameters suggested for Haystack-DS+ISW, with a suitable adaptation to account for this loss of combinatorial complexity.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of Haystack-PubDS+ISW, whose public dummy shuffling separately shuffles each slot using the same permutation.
parameters: Haystack-DS+ISW parameter set: baseline parameters to adapt when analyzing Haystack-PubDS+ISW
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether Haystack-PubDS+ISW has security comparable to Haystack-DS+ISW after accounting for its reduced combinatorial complexity.

citations.label: Haystack ciphers : White-box countermeasures as Symmetric encryption

progress.summary: The source conjectures comparable security because no attacks specific to public dummy shuffling are known. It calls for further cryptanalysis using suitably adapted Haystack-DS+ISW parameters.
